skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the basic concepts and functions of natural resource management.
Recognize and comply with legal regulations related to natural resource management.
Evaluate and analyze the effectiveness of management tools and policies in natural resource management.
Work effectively in teams to address issues in natural resource management.
Conduct surveys and investigations on natural resources.
Develop plans and strategies for the conservation, development, and exploitation of natural resources.
Create and manage databases for natural resource management.
Effectively present findings and solutions related to natural resource management.
